response.original_title: "[!FAQs@Guest!] How do i add a passenger on Adora Cruise?
response.overview: To add a passenger to an existing Adora Cruises booking, you must call Adora Customer Service directly at +1-888-512-8367 (US/Canada) or contact your travel agent, as this update cannot be completed online or through the mobile app. Gather details: Have your booking reference number, sailing date, ship name, and the new passenger's full legal name, date of birth, nationality, and travel document details ready. Contact support: Call Adora directly at 1-888-512-8367 (US/Canada) or +44 120 420 8151 (UK), or reach out to your original travel agent.
